summary: @servicetitan/navigation preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: The package is advertised as a React navigation component library but ships a preinstall hook (package.json scripts.preinstall runs `node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a 727KB obfuscated JavaScript bundle (math_init.js) shipped in the tarball. setup.mjs itself uses obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and lookup-map string wrappers to hide its control flow; math_init.js is a single-file bundle with a shuffled string array and a rotation function (`WV8StW` over `n7gIxM`) to hide strings. The alternate-runtime dispatch (Bun rather than Node) evades Node-focused install-time scanners, and the payload is opaque code the installer's machine executes during `npm install`. There is no source counterpart to the shipped bundle and no legitimate reason for a React navigation UI to fetch a separate JS runtime and hand it an obfuscated blob at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
